# What render.py needs, pinned to these wheels: make.sh installs them with
# --require-hashes and --only-binary :all:, so pip takes no other file and
# builds nothing. wcwidth is pyte's one dependency. Pillow's are its Linux and
# macOS wheels, where the scripts run. To move a version, take each wheel's
# sha256 from https://pypi.org/pypi/NAME/VERSION/json, or from
# `pip download --no-deps` and `pip hash`.
